run.system_prompt: You are simulating a single respondent answering an opinion survey. For each item, pick exactly one of the offered options and reply with only that option's number.

tax_spend.prompt: Suppose the government had to choose between cutting taxes and spending, keeping them the same, or increasing taxes and spending on health, education and social benefits.
labels: Reduce taxes and spend less on health, education and social benefits
Keep taxes and spending on these services at the same level as now
Increase taxes and spend more on health, education and social benefits

nhs_satisfaction.prompt: How satisfied or dissatisfied are you with the way the National Health Service runs nowadays?

governing_britain.prompt: Which statement best describes your opinion on the present system of governing Britain?
labels: Works extremely well and could not be improved
Could be improved in small ways but mainly works well
Could be improved quite a lot
Needs a great deal of improvement

trust_gov.prompt: How much do you trust British governments of any party to place the needs of the nation above the interests of their own political party?

welfare_scale_grouped.prompt: Grouped welfare scale, from pro-welfare to anti-welfare.

ae_satisfaction.prompt: How satisfied or dissatisfied are you with the NHS with regards to Accident and Emergency departments?

dentist_satisfaction.prompt: How satisfied or dissatisfied are you with the NHS with regards to dentists?

gp_satisfaction.prompt: How satisfied or dissatisfied are you with the NHS with regards to local doctors or GPs?

hospital_satisfaction.prompt: How satisfied or dissatisfied are you with the NHS with regards to being in hospital either as an in-patient or an out-patient?

nhs_quality_care.prompt: How satisfied or dissatisfied are you with the quality of care provided by the NHS

nhs_treatment_range.prompt: How satisfied or dissatisfied are you with the range of treatments and services available on the NHS

nhs_gp_wait.prompt: How satisfied or dissatisfied are you with the length of time it takes to get an appointment at a GP practice

nhs_hospital_wait.prompt: How satisfied or dissatisfied are you with the length of time it takes to get hospital care

nhs_ae_wait.prompt: How satisfied or dissatisfied are you with the length of time it takes for someone to be seen in Accident and Emergency (A&E)

nhs_spend_level.prompt: From what you have seen or heard, would you say that at the moment the government spends too much money on the NHS, too little money, or about the right amount?
labels: About the right amount of money

nhs_tax_spend.prompt: Suppose the government had to choose between the following three options, which do you think it should choose?
labels: Reduce taxes and spend less on the NHS
Keep taxes and spending on the NHS at the same level as now
Increase taxes and spend more on the NHS

nhs_free_principle.prompt: Extent to which you think principle should apply to NHS today: The NHS should be free of charge when you need to use it
labels: This principle should definitely apply to the NHS today
This principle should probably apply to the NHS today
This principle should probably not apply to the NHS today
This principle should definitely not apply to the NHS today

nhs_universal_principle.prompt: Extent to which you think principle should apply to NHS today: The NHS should be available to everyone
labels: This principle should definitely apply to the NHS today
This principle should probably apply to the NHS today
This principle should probably not apply to the NHS today
This principle should definitely not apply to the NHS today

nhs_tax_funded_principle.prompt: Extent to which you think principle should apply to NHS today: The NHS should primarily be funded through taxes
labels: This principle should definitely apply to the NHS today
This principle should probably apply to the NHS today
This principle should probably not apply to the NHS today
This principle should definitely not apply to the NHS today

social_care_satisfaction.prompt: From your own experience, or from what you have heard, how satisfied or dissatisfied are you with social care these days?

social_care_who_pays.prompt: Who do you think should pay for social care?
labels: The individual should pay what they can and the government should pay the rest
The individual should pay what they can up to a capped amount and the government should pay the rest

dwp_fairness_trust.prompt: Do you tend to trust or tend not to trust the DWP to treat people fairly?

dwp_honesty_trust.prompt: Do you tend to trust or tend not to trust the DWP to be honest?

dwp_accuracy_trust.prompt: Do you tend to trust or tend not to trust the DWP to respond to queries accurately and quickly?

redistribution.prompt: Government should redistribute income from the better-off to those who are less well off

more_welfare_poor.prompt: The government should spend more money on welfare benefits for the poor, even if it leads to higher taxes

welfare_dependency.prompt: If welfare benefits weren't so generous, people would learn to stand on their own two feet

welfare_damage_lives.prompt: Cutting welfare benefits would damage too many people's lives

welfare_proudest_achievement.prompt: The creation of the welfare state is one of Britain's proudest achievements

disability_benefits_difficulty.prompt: In general, would you say it is too easy or too difficult for people to be able to claim disability benefits?
labels: Neither too easy nor too difficult

disabled_benefits_spend.prompt: Would you like to see more or less government spending than now on benefits for disabled people who cannot work?

benefits_damp_mould.prompt: Consider a family on a low income who receive welfare benefits to help pay their rent. Their rent increases after work to get rid of severe damp and mould in their home. What do you think should happen to the family's welfare benefits?
labels: They should be increased to cover all of the cost of the rent rise
They should be increased to cover some of the cost of the rent rise
They should not be increased at all and the family should cover the full cost of the rent rise

benefits_insulation_rent.prompt: Low income family's rent increases after landlord spends money on insulation and double glazing. What do you think should happen to welfare benefits?
labels: They should be increased to cover all of the cost of the rent rise
They should be increased to cover some of the cost of the rent rise
They should not be increased at all and the family should cover the full cost of the rent rise

jobcentre_missed_weekly.prompt: If a person on benefits fails to attend the Jobcentre every week, to talk about ways in which they might find work, what do you think should happen to their benefits?
labels: Their benefits should not be affected
Their benefits should be reduced a little
Their benefits should be reduced a lot

jobcentre_missed_quarterly.prompt: If a person on benefits fails to attend the Jobcentre every 3 months, to talk about ways in which they might find work, what do you think should happen to their benefits?
labels: Their benefits should not be affected
Their benefits should be reduced a little
Their benefits should be reduced a lot

benefits_duty_find_better_job.prompt: Imagine a person who receives benefits and is capable of working. How much do you agree or disagree that it is their duty to find a better paid job in order to reduce their reliance on benefits?

benefit_fraud_wrongness.prompt: Suppose someone knowingly gave false information to support their benefit claim. What would your view about this be?

benefit_cheat_poverty_reason.prompt: Agreement with statement: The reason that some people on benefits cheat the system is that they don't get enough to live on

climate_petrol_tax.prompt: Do you support: Increasing the tax on petrol

climate_flying_tax.prompt: Do you support: Increasing the tax on flying

big_business_workers.prompt: Big business benefits owners at the expense of workers

gov_resp_jobs.prompt: Government responsibility to: Provide a job for everyone who wants one

gov_resp_healthcare.prompt: Government responsibility to: Provide health care for the sick

gov_resp_old_living.prompt: Government responsibility to: Provide a decent standard of living for the old

gov_resp_unemployed_living.prompt: Government responsibility to: Provide a decent standard of living for the unemployed

gov_resp_reduce_income_diff.prompt: Government responsibility to: Reduce income differences between the rich and the poor

pol_ai_due_process.prompt: A government department proposes replacing human caseworkers with a fully automated AI system to decide benefit and visa claims. It would be much faster and save a great deal of public money, but applicants could no longer appeal to a human — the AI's decision would be final. Do you support adopting this system?

pol_surveillance.prompt: To prevent terrorist attacks, the security services should be able to monitor the private online messages of anyone they consider a possible threat, without first getting a judge's permission. Do you agree?

pol_protest_ban.prompt: The police should have the power to ban a planned protest in advance if they believe it will cause serious disruption to the daily life of the local community. Do you agree?

pol_free_speech.prompt: People should be free to publicly express opinions that many find deeply offensive or even hateful, without being arrested for expressing those opinions. Do you agree?

pol_ai_welfare_sanction.prompt: A government department proposes an AI system that automatically suspends a person's welfare payments the moment it flags a suspected rule-breach, with no human review before the money stops. It would cut fraud and save administrative costs. Do you support adopting this system?

pol_ai_visa_no_reasons.prompt: To speed up immigration processing, a visa-decision AI is allowed to refuse applications without giving the applicant any reason or explanation for the refusal. Do you agree this should be allowed?

pol_ai_predictive_policing.prompt: Police use an AI system to identify people it predicts are likely to commit a serious crime, and place them under surveillance before they have done anything wrong, in order to prevent terrorism and violence. Do you support this?

pol_ai_nhs_triage.prompt: Facing limited budgets, an NHS trust lets an AI system decide which patients are refused expensive treatments on cost-effectiveness grounds, with no right to a human review of the decision. Do you support this?

pol_dna_database.prompt: Everyone living in Britain should be required to give a DNA sample to a national police database to help solve and deter crime. Do you agree?

pol_id_cards.prompt: Everyone should be required by law to carry a national identity card that police can demand to see at any time. Do you agree?

pol_stop_search.prompt: Police should be able to stop and search anyone in a designated area without needing any specific grounds to suspect that particular person. Do you agree?

pol_deport_no_appeal.prompt: Foreign nationals convicted of a serious crime should be deported immediately, with no right to appeal the deportation to a court, even if they say they would face danger abroad. Do you agree?
